narrative: The technology sector is buzzing with developments across AI, infrastructure, and space. Key highlights include Amazon's expansion of Alexa into new markets, Google's investment in AI for filmmaking, and significant advancements in space exploration by NASA and SpaceX.

highlights.title: Amazon is testing Alexa+ in India with Hindi support
highlights.whyItMatters: Amazon is expanding its voice assistant services with local language support, indicating a push into new markets.

highlights.title: From pledge to practice: Building a more inclusive open source ecosystem
highlights.whyItMatters: GitHub's initiative highlights ongoing efforts to improve accessibility and inclusivity in open-source development.

highlights.title: Google invests in A24 to build AI movie tools
highlights.whyItMatters: Google's DeepMind is collaborating with a film studio to integrate AI into movie production, potentially transforming filmmaking.

highlights.title: Doorbell cam filmed Tesla Autopilot crash that killed woman in her home
highlights.whyItMatters: This incident raises critical safety concerns about autonomous driving technologies and their real-world implications.

highlights.title: Valve is working with AMD to bring FSR 4 to the Steam Machine
highlights.whyItMatters: Collaboration between Valve and AMD aims to enhance gaming performance on the Steam Machine with advanced upscaling technology.

highlights.title: SpaceX inks compute deal with Reflection AI, an open source AI lab
highlights.whyItMatters: SpaceX is providing significant computing resources to an open-source AI lab, fueling advancements in AI research.

highlights.title: NASA to Cover US Spacewalk 95, Host Preview News Conference
highlights.whyItMatters: NASA is preparing for a critical spacewalk to maintain the International Space Station, showcasing ongoing human space exploration efforts.
